name: Digicel Business Anguilla colocation/data-centre service
notes: Official Digicel Business Anguilla product page states colocation provides rented space in a data-centre for customer servers/computing hardware. Official Digicel Business contact page gives Fredrick O' Harrigan Building, Rock Farm, The Valley, Anguilla. Government of Anguilla waste-management geography places Rock Farm and Stoney Ground in the same Valley/North-South service zone; exact district boundary for the facility is not independently confirmed, so division assignment is cautious. No public MW capacity found.
